name: Mountains
hint: Landscapes and nature as the subject: mountains, valleys, rivers, beaches, forests, trails, sky, sunsets. People absent or small.

name: Group photos
hint: Three or more people, or two people photographed by someone else.

name: Selfies
hint: Front-camera or arm's-length shots of one or two people with faces close to the camera.

name: Food
hint: Meals, drinks, snacks, cafe tables, cooking.

name: Roads & drives
hint: Roads, highways, vehicles, bus, train or car interiors, views from a moving vehicle, stops on the way.

name: Stays
hint: Hotels, hostels, homes, camps, tents, rooms, cafes and buildings, night hangouts.

name: Screenshots
hint: Phone screenshots or screen captures: maps, tickets, chats, payments, documents.
